scripts.timings:prepare: npm run timings:download && npm run timings:generate && npm run timings:validate
scripts.android:build: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.build:apk: npm run build && npx cap sync android && cd android && .\gradlew.bat assembleDebug && copy /Y app\build\outputs\apk\debug\app-debug.apk ..\artifacts\quran-latest.apk
scripts.build:android:release: npm run build && npx cap sync android && cd android && .\gradlew.bat assembleRelease bundleRelease && if exist app\build\outputs\apk\release\app-release.apk (copy /Y app\build\outputs\apk\release\app-release.apk ..\artifacts\quran-latest.apk) else (copy /Y app\build\outputs\apk\release\app-release-unsigned.apk ..\artifacts\quran-latest.apk) && copy /Y app\build\outputs\bundle\release\app-release.aab ..\artifacts\quran-latest.aab
